get_index_to_rotate: get the connected component atom indexes to rotate after splitting a torsion bond in a molecular graph
set_torsion_on_multiple_molecules: rotate atoms by a delta angle around a torsion axis for multiple molecules using axis-angle rotation matrices
set_torsions: set target torsion angles on molecular positions by computing deltas and applying rotations using RDKit conventions
grad_pos_E_to_grad_tor_E: compute the gradient of energy with respect to torsion angles from position-space gradients using vjp
review_rotate_module: review the rotate module functions for molecular torsion angle manipulation and gradient computation
